get.description:
Retrieve portfolio holdings across wallets and DeFi protocols.

**Cost:** 1 credit per call

**Get your API key:** [Dev Portal](https://data.octav.fi)

parameters.name: addresses
parameters.description: EVM or SOL wallet address to retrieve portfolio data for

parameters.name: includeImages
parameters.description: Include image URLs for chains, assets, and protocols

parameters.name: includeExplorerUrls
parameters.description: Include blockchain explorer URLs for assets and transactions

parameters.name: waitForSync
parameters.description: Wait for fresh data if cache is stale

networth.description: Total portfolio net worth in USD

get.description:
Retrieve a single Ethereum address's portfolio valued at a specific historical block. Requires the Portfolio at Block add-on to be enabled for your API key.

**Cost:** Set monthly fee under the Portfolio at Block add-on, plus 1 credit per call

**Rate limit:** 100 requests/min on a dedicated bucket

**Get your API key:** [Dev Portal](https://data.octav.fi)

parameters.name: addresses
parameters.description: A single EVM wallet address to retrieve portfolio data for. Only one address is accepted per call.

parameters.name: chainKey
parameters.description: Chain the block belongs to. Only ethereum is currently supported.

parameters.name: blockNumber
parameters.description: The block number to value the portfolio at. Must be a positive integer.

200.description: Successful response — same shape as GET /portfolio (an array with one portfolio for the requested address), each portfolio carrying a top-level blockNumber field

blockNumber.description: The block number the portfolio was valued at (echoes the blockNumber query parameter, returned as a string)

networth.description: Total portfolio net worth in USD, valued at blockNumber

assetByProtocols.description: Assets organized by protocol, valued at blockNumber

chains.description: Assets organized by blockchain (only ethereum is present)

400.description: Validation error — missing/invalid addresses, chainKey, or blockNumber

details.description: Joi validation error details, keyed by request segment (e.g. query)

401.description: Missing/invalid API key, or the Portfolio at Block add-on is not enabled for this key

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — 100 requests/min on this endpoint's dedicated bucket

500.description: Upstream failure fetching Portfolio at Block data

get.description:
List all virtual users belonging to the authenticated API user. Requires a Pro subscription — virtual users are created in the [Octav Pro](https://pro.octav.fi) app.

**Cost:** 1 credit per call

**Get your API key:** [Dev Portal](https://data.octav.fi)

address.description: Virtual user identifier in virtual:<id> format

get.description:
Fetch portfolios for one or more virtual users. Works identically to GET /portfolio but uses virtual user addresses. Requires a Pro subscription.

**Cost:** 1 credit per virtual user address

**Get your API key:** [Dev Portal](https://data.octav.fi)

parameters.name: addresses
parameters.description: Comma-separated virtual user addresses (from the list endpoint). Format: virtual:<id>. Max 10.

parameters.name: aggregated
parameters.description: Return a single reduced portfolio across all virtual users

parameters.name: waitForSync
parameters.description: Wait for fresh data if cache is stale

parameters.name: includeImages
parameters.description: Include image URLs for chains, assets, and protocols

parameters.name: includeExplorerUrls
parameters.description: Include blockchain explorer URLs for assets and transactions

200.description: Successful response — same schema as GET /portfolio

networth.description: Total portfolio net worth in USD

403.description: Forbidden — one or more virtual user addresses do not belong to this account

get.description:
Query transaction history with powerful filtering and search.

**Cost:** 1 credit per call

**Get your API key:** [Dev Portal](https://data.octav.fi)

parameters.name: addresses
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM or SOL)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of transactions per page (1-250, recommended 10-50)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset (0-based)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order by timestamp (DESC=newest first, ASC=oldest first)

parameters.name: initialSearchText
parameters.description: Full-text search in transaction assets (token symbols, names, addresses)

parameters.name: interactingAddresses
parameters.description: Filter by interacting addresses (comma-separated)

parameters.name: networks
parameters.description: Filter by blockchain networks (comma-separated chain keys)

parameters.name: txTypes
parameters.description:
Filter by transaction types (comma-separated)

See [Transaction Types](https://octav-0131e508.mintlify.app/api/reference/transaction-types)

parameters.name: protocols
parameters.description:
Filter by protocol keys (comma-separated)

See [Protocol Keys](https://protocols.octav.fi/)

parameters.name: hideSpam
parameters.description: Exclude spam transactions

parameters.name: hideDust
parameters.description: Exclude dust transactions

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the date range (ISO 8601, UTC). Inclusive: timestamp >= startDate, compared at the exact instant passed. Optional — omit to start from the wallet's first indexed transaction. camelCase only (start_date returns 400).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the date range (ISO 8601, UTC). Rounded up to the end of that calendar day (23:59:59Z); time-of-day is ignored. Inclusive: timestamp <= endOfDay(endDate). Optional. camelCase only (end_date returns 400).

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Filter by NFT token ID

get.description:
Look up which DeFi protocol a contract address belongs to. Provide a `chain` to resolve a single protocol on that chain, or omit it to search by address across all chains.

**Cost:** 5 credits per lookup. The credits are refunded if no protocol is found (404).

**Get your API key:** [Dev Portal](https://data.octav.fi)

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: The contract address to look up (EVM `0x…` or Solana base58).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Chain key (e.g. `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, `base`, `polygon`, `solana`). If omitted, the endpoint returns every chain the address is known on.

200.description: Protocol match. Returns a single `{ protocol }` object when `chain` is provided, or a `{ protocols }` array (each entry tagged with its `chainKey`) when `chain` is omitted. The array is unordered.

oneOf.description: Returned when `chain` is omitted (all matches across chains)

401.description: Missing/invalid API key or no access to the endpoint

message.example: Error while searching for contract protocol

get.description:
Paginated reward buckets aggregated by epoch, day, week, or month for a validator identified by index.

**Cost:** 1 credit per call. Automatically refunded on 4xx/5xx responses.

**Access:** Requires portfolio entitlement.

**Rate limit:** 360 req/min (shared with portfolio bucket)

**Get your API key:** [Dev Portal](https://data.octav.fi)

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Non-negative validator index

parameters.name: rangeType
parameters.description: Determines how rangeFrom/rangeTo are interpreted. `timestamp` = Unix seconds (max range 31,536,000 s); `epoch` = beacon epoch numbers (max range 82,125 epochs).

parameters.name: rangeFrom
parameters.description: Start of the range (inclusive). Must be ≥ 0 and ≤ rangeTo. Interpreted per rangeType.

parameters.name: rangeTo
parameters.description: End of the range (inclusive). Must be ≥ 0. Interpreted per rangeType.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Bucket size for aggregation.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return. Max 10.
